description: The Bhāgavata Purāṇa (Śrīmad Bhāgavatam) is one of the eighteen Mahāpurāṇas, traditionally attributed to Vyāsa and narrated by Śuka to King Parīkṣit, as retold by Sūta to the sages at Naimiṣāraṇya. This build ships the complete sa.wikisource.org mūla: 12 skandhas, 335 adhyāyas, 14098 numbered verses parsed from that edition on 2026-09-22 (CC BY-SA 4.0). Traditional ~18,000 is an approximation, not an import target. English and Malayalam translations remain original Dharma Library drafts on 1.1.1–1.1.10 only; other verses have no invented translation. GRETIL was collated as a scholarly witness and is not shipped.
